title: Define privacy model

classes.meaning: intended for public publication/discovery once canonical publication gates pass
shareable by explicit reference but excluded from broad discovery/search unless later promoted
creator/account scoped content inaccessible to public projections by default
credentials, keys, tokens or other data that must never be persisted in application records, public manifests, logs or indexes

dataRules.publicTransition: never automatic; explicit publication only if a future feature separately defines it
only selected output may become publishable after review/rights/provenance gates
commitments/IDs only; hidden payloads remain private
dataRules.indexing: allowed when attached to published canonical object

dataRules.publicTransition: reference/commitment only, subject to underlying privacy
only minimal consent reference/status may be public; raw evidence remains private unless source policy says otherwise

dataRules.indexing: allowed when required for published provenance

dataRules.storage: must not be accepted or persisted by 420Hz
secret manager/runtime injection only; never application content

dataRules.publicTransition: subject to future user privacy preference if supported
never expose voter secret/signature material; published result may expose only policy-approved aggregate/commitment

providerRules: Private execution payloads must use authenticated encrypted off-chain transport/storage.
Provider/worker access is assignment-scoped, least-privilege, time-bounded and limited to data required for the exact accepted job.
An accepted compute/AI assignment is not permission for cross-project, cross-job, account-wide or dataset-wide access.
Plaintext prompts, reference audio, draft lyrics and output bytes must not be persisted in public runtime state or logs.
Expired, revoked, wrong-scope or wrong-assignment payload access fails closed.
420Hz may send only the minimum data required by the selected generation request and privacy policy.
encryptionAndStorage: Where 420AI private payload services are used, preserve their authenticated-encryption and assignment-scoped access guarantees rather than downgrading to plaintext transport/storage.
Raw private media/content remains off-chain by default.
Public chain/protocol state may contain only bounded IDs, commitments, policy versions and minimally necessary public references.
Low-entropy private data must not rely on an unsalted plain hash as confidentiality protection.
Exact retention/deletion durations are deferred to HZ-GCA-1.8, but HZ-GCA-1.7 requires bounded retention and no indefinite provider/runtime copies by default.
indexingRules: 420Indexer/Search receive only data explicitly eligible for public projection.
PRIVATE and SECRET data are excluded from public Indexer/Search projections.
UNLISTED objects are excluded from broad Search/trending/discovery unless explicitly promoted to PUBLIC.
Hashes, commitments or ciphertext references do not authorize recovery, decryption or indexing of protected payloads.
Draft Generate objects remain non-indexable before publication.
Search ranking/discovery cannot broaden visibility beyond the source object's privacy class.
notificationRules: 420Notifications may receive minimal event metadata needed for opt-in delivery, not raw private prompts/audio/stems/consent payloads.
Subscription state, watchlists, delivery endpoints and notification history remain private by default.
Notification delivery does not make the underlying private source object public.
Promotional notification consent remains separate from operational/security delivery.
loggingTelemetryRules: Logs, traces, metrics and CI artifacts must redact or omit prompts, lyrics, raw audio bytes, private stems, access tokens, credentials, wallet secrets and raw consent evidence.
Operational metrics may expose aggregate latency/capacity/error data without customer payload contents.
Crash reports and provider diagnostics must preserve the same privacy classification and redaction rules.
No debug mode may silently disable production privacy/redaction semantics in qualification or production.
lifecycleRules: DRAFT, QUOTED, SUBMITTED, RUNNING and SUCCEEDED generation content remains private unless a field is explicitly defined public.
REVIEWED makes disclosure/provenance candidates complete but does not itself publish private payloads.
REGISTERED may publish canonical Creative commitments/IDs while hidden source payloads remain private.
PUBLISHED exposes only fields explicitly classified PUBLIC for the exact Recording/version.
Withdrawal/restriction stops current public availability where canonical policy requires but does not erase immutable public commitments already legitimately published.
Privacy class changes require explicit user/policy action and must not be inferred from link sharing, successful generation or registration.
accessRules: Wallet/account authorization gates access to private creator projects; connection alone is insufficient for signing or broad data access.
Optional Identity assertions may gate policy where needed but do not grant access to unrelated private content.
Storage/provider access tokens are purpose-scoped and may not be reused as application-session or wallet authority.
Moderation/arbitration evidence access, where later applicable, must be separately authorized and does not make evidence public.
failClosedRules: attempt to public-index PRIVATE or SECRET data fails closed
attempt to broad-index UNLISTED data fails closed
provider access with expired/wrong-scope assignment fails closed
missing privacy-policy/reference on a private AI job fails closed where the owning 420AI policy requires one
plaintext secret/credential persistence in application records or logs is invalid
publication request with unresolved field visibility/classification fails closed
notification payload containing raw protected generation content is rejected
search/discovery visibility may never exceed source visibility
debug/telemetry configuration that would leak protected payloads is invalid
invariants: HZGCA-PRIV-001 Generate project, intent, run, output, artifact, provenance-draft and publish-intent objects are private by default
HZGCA-PRIV-002 prompts, private lyric drafts, reference audio, draft outputs, private stems and raw consent evidence are off-chain/private by default
HZGCA-PRIV-003 wallet private keys, provider credentials and bearer/session secrets are SECRET and never valid public/application content
HZGCA-PRIV-004 private AI/Compute payload access is authenticated, encrypted, least-privilege, assignment-scoped and time-bounded
HZGCA-PRIV-005 successful generation, review or registration never automatically changes private content to public
HZGCA-PRIV-006 only explicitly PUBLIC data may enter public Indexer/Search projections
HZGCA-PRIV-007 UNLISTED objects remain excluded from broad Search/trending/discovery
HZGCA-PRIV-008 hashes/commitments/ciphertext references do not authorize recovery or disclosure of protected payloads
HZGCA-PRIV-009 logs/metrics/CI artifacts never contain raw prompts, private media, credentials, tokens or raw consent evidence
HZGCA-PRIV-010 provider execution never grants cross-job/cross-project access
HZGCA-PRIV-011 420Notifications retains private subscription/delivery policy and never republishes protected payloads
HZGCA-PRIV-012 privacy class transitions require explicit user/policy action and are never inferred from sharing or execution success
HZGCA-PRIV-013 published provenance exposes commitments/references, not protected plaintext
HZGCA-PRIV-014 moderation/arbitration evidence access is separately authorized and does not imply public visibility
HZGCA-PRIV-015 retention is bounded; exact deletion/retention policy remains HZ-GCA-1.8
HZGCA-PRIV-016 source visibility is an upper bound for Search/Notification projection visibility
HZGCA-PRIV-017 missing/conflicting privacy classification fails closed at publication/indexing boundaries
HZGCA-PRIV-018 privacy protections do not create new rights, identity, payment, governance or protocol authority
exitCriteria: Generate/Community/Awards data classes and default visibility are explicit
private prompts/lyrics/reference audio/drafts/stems/consent payload handling is explicit
provider/worker least-privilege encrypted off-chain access rules are explicit
public Indexer/Search/Notification exclusion and visibility rules are explicit
lifecycle privacy transitions and fail-closed ambiguity are explicit
retention is bounded with exact retention/deletion deferred only to HZ-GCA-1.8
machine verifier enforces classes, protected-data exclusions, projection rules and privacy invariants
no ABI, deployment, live provider or testnet state is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.8 through HZ-GCA-1.20
